results.title: Explainer: SK hynix's Mid-to-Long-Term Investment Strategy
results.content: Having grown on the foundation of its production bases in Icheon and Cheongju, SK hynix is now preparing for its next leap forward by expanding its manufacturing footprint to Yongin and onward to the Southwestern Region. As long as demand continues and the necessary infrastructure is in place, SK hynix will further strengthen its contribution to the advancement of the global AI ecosystem. SK hynix will continue to anticipate and lead market growth through proactive investment based on [...] To respond to these market changes, SK hynix has established a KRW 1,100 trillion mid-to-long-term investment strategy encompassing Yongin, Cheongju, and the Southwestern Region. The company plans to invest KRW 600 trillion in Yongin, KRW 100 trillion in Cheongju, and KRW 400 trillion in the Southwestern Region in phases. [...] SK hynix’s mid-to-long-term investment strategy begins with its responsibility as a global memory leader to respond reliably to rapidly growing AI memory demand. Resolving global memory supply shortages and establishing a stable supply chain are essential foundations for the continued development of the global AI ecosystem.
